THE SOLUTION SUITE - WINDOWS INSTALL
====================================

1. Close your DAW.
2. Copy everything inside the VST3 folder to:
     C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\The Solution\
3. (Optional) Copy everything inside the CLAP folder to:
     C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP\The Solution\
4. Copy everything inside the Skins folder to:
     C:\ProgramData\FastRayMedia\The Solution\Skins\
   (Paste %ProgramData% into the File Explorer address bar to get
   there, then create the FastRayMedia\The Solution\Skins folders.)
   All 13 plugins share these images. Without them the plugins
   still work, just without the photo faceplates.
5. Open your DAW and rescan plugins.

The Standalone folder has each module as a regular app you can
double-click to run without a DAW.

These builds are not code-signed. If Windows SmartScreen warns you
about a Standalone .exe, click "More info" then "Run anyway".
